parents.subject: LU-20354 quota: aggregate MD inode usage for GETQUOTA

commit.subject: LU-20354 quota: serve LQA usage from QMT cache
commit.message:
LU-20354 quota: serve LQA usage from QMT cache

GETQUOTALQA previously returned limits only. Wire it through the
usage cache so lfs quota --lqa can set QIF_SPACE/QIF_INODES from
the LQA shared lqe (qid=1). LQA has no llite fan-out and no
per-slave DQACQ piggyback, so a miss collects glb IDs in the
current ranges and batch-fetches each slave with
LUSTRE_Q_GETOQUOTAIDS (list mode). Per-slave range sums land on
the shared lqe with the existing TTL; reply lists also warm
already cached per-ID global slots. Any slave failure aborts
(no granted fallback, no partial sum). QIF_SPACE follows DT
alone and QIF_INODES follows MD alone. Treat LQA inacc like
GETQUOTA in lfs.

Range add/remove bumps qpi_lqa_gen with the rbtree update.
Later GETQUOTALQA sees lqu_lqa_gen != qpi_lqa_gen, treats the
slots as stale, and refreshes. The bump stays under the same
write_lock as insert/erase so the new tree and new generation
become visible together.

Add MDT/OFD GETOQUOTAIDS handlers, OSP/LOD iobuf async, and
mdt_qmt_fetch_ids_batch. Cover with kunit and sanity-quota/312
(MDS >= 2.17.58). Document LQA behavior in the usage_cache_*
man pages.
